propositions: The ticket-type map is duplicated in both jira and jira_datacenter adapter modules, creating risk of silent divergence like the status-map defect fe15.
The existing boundary guard covers status and priority maps but not the ticket-type map, allowing reintroduction of duplicates to pass testing.

Both _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE copies must be unified into a single definition in adapters/jira_family/value_maps.py and imported under the historical private alias to keep external test consumers resolvable.

The module-attribute consumer at test_outbound_differ_session_log_exclusion.py:87 requires absolute import binding strategy, not relative, because outbound_fields is loaded via spec_from_file_location with no package context in tests.
The boundary guard must be extended to walk dict literals under adapters/ and verify exactly one _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE-equivalent definition exists.
